## Research & Work

**Doctoral Candidate** · University of Augsburg, Chair of Mechatronics\
*May 2024 – present · Augsburg*

PhD research on methods that combine system simulation and scientific machine learning to design and operate sustainable energy systems more efficiently, within the European research project [OpenSCALING](https://itea4.org/project/openscaling.html).

**Working Student Research & Development** · XRG Simulation GmbH\
*Oct 2022 – Apr 2024 · Hamburg*

Applied probabilistic machine learning in the research project [PHyMoS](https://phymos.de/). Led a contribution to the Modelica Conference 2023 (*Efficient Global Multi Parameter Calibration for Complex System Models Using Machine-Learning Surrogates*), gave an internal machine-learning training, and wrote my master's thesis.

**Lab Affiliate** · Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory\
*2022 · Berkeley, USA*

Energy Analysis & Environmental Impacts Division. Supported the project [GEMINI-XFC](https://www.energy.gov/eere/vehicles/articles/grid-enhanced-mobility-integrated-network-infrastructures-extreme-fast-0) by developing a controller for charging depots of automated on-demand vehicle fleets.

**Student Intern** · Siemens Gamesa\
*Apr 2021 – Jul 2021 · Hamburg*

Research & development team for ETES (Electric Thermal Energy Storage).

**Research Student Assistant** · Institute of Engineering Thermodynamics, TUHH\
*Sep 2019 – Sep 2020 · Hamburg*

Heating system simulation with Modelica and Dymola.

**Tutor** · Hamburg University of Technology\
*Oct 2018 – Jan 2021 · Hamburg*

Tutor for Technical Thermodynamics (2020/21) and StartING tutor at the Student Counseling Center, helping first-year students get started professionally and socially.
